name: Rosetta
def: Robotic space probe which orbited comet 67P/Churyumov–Gerasimenko.

excerpt.text: Rosetta was a space probe built by the European Space Agency that launched on 2 March 2004. Along with Philae, its lander module, Rosetta performed a detailed study of comet 67P/Churyumov–Gerasimenko (67P).
excerpt.title: Rosetta (spacecraft)
